messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Pre-release of poppr version 2.1.1
parts:
Hi all,

I'm planning on releasing poppr version 2.1.1 next week and I wanted to make sure that nothing breaks for anyone.

Details can be found on GitHub: https://github.com/grunwaldlab/poppr/issues/89. As always, you can install it with devtools:

devtools::install_github("grunwaldlab/poppr", build_vignettes = TRUE)

Please comment on GitHub if you see anything that needs to be changed.

- Zhian

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: Pre-release of poppr version 2.1.1
parts:
This version has been officially released on CRAN. Binaries for OSX and Windows will be built within the next few days.

Details here: https://github.com/grunwaldlab/poppr/releases/tag/v.2.1.1

Zhian
